_comment: Reproduces the documented Ring defect (r/Ring, 'Wheelchair user indentified as package', 20 Aug 2026): a motorized wheelchair user's arrival is tagged sub_type=package instead of human. Threshold must still count this as front-door activity, because events.py and schedule.py never gate on sub_type. See tests/test_events.py and tests/test_schedule.py for the assertions this fixture backs.
